events.body:
## Context

The blt-pool row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv` runs only `test_worker.py` and `test_forge_leaderboard.py`, and compiles only `src/worker.py src/services`. `test_checks_api.py` and `test_check_orchestrator.py` (21 tests, passing locally) never run, and `src/checks_api.py` is never compiled, although `src/worker.py` imports both modules.

## What to do

1. Add both files to the blt-pool row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv` (or run `python -m pytest -q`), and add `src/checks_api.py` to the compileall list.
2. Update the README Testing section and project tree.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `scripts/ci/test.sh blt-pool` runs all four test files
- [ ] README matches

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-pool
```

---
